hoy.titular: Now Castro: a second muscle tear and another absence for the Supercopa
hoy.resumen: Alexis Castro joins Tucu Correa on the sidelines with a grade 2 calf tear: both miss Thursday's Supercopa. The club is optimistic about having them for Palmeiras on the 28th.
puntos: Supercopa tickets: online via Deportick, from ARS 65,000 to ARS 140,000, with ID.
Coaches to Montevideo (ARS 50,000 return, in the UNO app): Thursday 12 for members with 400+ points, Friday 13 for the rest, Saturday 14 general sale.
Carrillo and Gaich remain up front, and Baltasar Rodríguez looks set to come in. Palacios is carrying a knee niggle: if he doesn't make it, Rojo starts.

linea.texto: The club confirmed Alexis Castro has a grade 2 calf tear: he misses the Supercopa and is a doubt for the final.
The reserves beat San Martín (SJ) 3-0 at City Bell, with another fine afternoon from Franco Domínguez Ávila, and remain in the play-off race.
The squad train at City Bell, travel to Córdoba on Wednesday afternoon and will stay at the Quinto Centenario hotel.
